set up claude in a project, telemetry, shell completion or restore

Usage:
  cld setup [command]

Available Commands:
  project     set claude up in the project in the current directory
  telemetry   send claude's telemetry through a local OpenTelemetry collector
  completion  set up cld's completion in bash, zsh or fish
  restore     have your systemd run cld restore at login, or at boot

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for setup

Use "cld setup [command] --help" for more information about a command.
